name: A big date with a big guy
source:
In this game, you go on a dating site, find this guy on it, the both of you meet up at a restaurant, and where the love story begins.

[Edited from [url=https://dragster02.itch.io/a-big-date-with-a-big-guy]Itch.io[/url]]
